name: write-picture-stipple-plot-without-seed
description: After 'pen N stipple', a plot can supply one seed followed by multiple x,y pairs. The seed carries over to subsequent pairs; a plot with no seed fails.

args.source:
vis 2
pri 6
rect 0,0 159,167
fill 80,80
pen 3 stipple
vis 10
plot 17 93,10 102,9 120,14
end
